description: Removes the 'seen' cycle-detection set from a recursive tree flattener, so a node graph containing a cycle (e.g. attacker-supplied JSON with a self-referential 'children' entry) recurses without bound instead of terminating.

findings.summary: Removing cycle detection makes flatten() recurse without bound on cyclic input
findings.evidence: The seen=set()/id(node) guard that stopped revisiting an already-flattened node was deleted; if node.get("children", []) ever forms a cycle (directly or indirectly attacker-controlled), flatten() recurses indefinitely until the process hits RecursionError or crashes.
